home.title: reverseshell
home.tagline: Client-side reverse shell generator for authorized security testing. Generate one-liners, listeners, obfuscation variants, and shell upgrade steps entirely in your browser.
home.client_side_note: 100% client-side. Built for authorized security testing only.
home.feature_payloads_title: Reverse, bind, staged, and HTTP callbacks
home.feature_payloads_desc: Bash, netcat, Python, PHP, PowerShell, socat, bind shells, curl staged payloads, and HoaxShell-style HTTP polling.
home.feature_encoders_desc: Base64 wrappers, '${IFS}', reversed strings, PowerShell encoding, chunking, URL encoding, and chr() rebuilds.
home.feature_formats_desc: Generate handlers, copy shell upgrade recipes, and export a markdown engagement card for your lab notes.
home.feature_collections_desc: Load curated presets or save your own configurations with JSON import and export.

footer.tagline: Authorized security testing only. All processing happens in your browser.

blog.title: Blog
blog.description: Notes and updates for authorized security testing workflows.
blog.intro: Short guides and release notes for lab workflows. All generation still runs locally in your browser.

welcome.title: Welcome to reverseshell
welcome.excerpt: How to use the builder, listener page, and engagement card export in authorized labs.
welcome.body: Open the home page builder to pick a template, set LHOST/LPORT, and copy or export commands. Use the listener page for handler one-liners, collections for presets, and the engagement card export to capture configuration and notes in markdown.
